endorsements.name: Alek Amrani
endorsements.label: Pre-Con Introduction to Lock Picking
endorsements.description: Make it out before DEF CON starts, and venture into lock sporting with the Longhorn Lock Picking Club. Learn to lock pick from one of the largest lock sporting organizations in the western hemisphere. This is a great opportunity for anyone trying to dodge the incredibly popular (read: crowded) Lock Picking Village but don't want to try learning on their own.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 17

endorsements.name: Alek Amrani
endorsements.label: Session Donation
endorsements.description: It's easier to give away than it is to take. Apply that theory to Session Hijacking, and enter Session Donation. Session Donation is a computer session attack that attempts to gain information by taking session hijacking in an entirely new direction. Session Donation is an interesting new spin on an old attack that is much harder to prevent than it's predecessor, and equally as dangerous.
